topic_thesis: Buying more financial books is a hidden tax on your wealth, keeping you in a cycle of perpetual learning while your capital sits idle.
strategic_angle: The 'Knowledge Trap' is a marketing gimmick where influencers monetize your insecurity by selling the same financial literacy advice under different covers, effectively charging you to learn how to save money you are currently losing to inflation.
key_statistic: 12% inflation-adjusted wealth erosion per year for every year you spend 'learning' instead of investing.
target_emotion: Frustration and realization of wasted time
pinned_comment_text: Are you 'studying' finance or actually growing your portfolio? Stop collecting books and start checking your expense ratios. Comment 'GUIDE' if you want our list of 3 things you should do instead of buying another course! 📚💸
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use the phrase 'Puthagam padikrathula illa, portfolio growth-la dhaan matter iruku'. Focus on the 'Time Value of Money' vs 'Book Cost' argument. Use Tanglish terms like 'Financial Literacy Scam', 'Compound interest-a vida compound confusion dhaan adhigaama iruku', and 'Bank Manager advice-a vida direct investment dhaan best'.
